relocationSmoke.meaning: The cloned closure restored the checkpoint while its donor runtime and source roots were denied.

independentMaterialization.meaning: A fresh acquisition needs the interpreter, wheel/source inputs, install environment, assembly staging and output simultaneously. A donor clone is not a clean acquisition proof.

nextAction: On scratch storage with enough capacity, acquire the pinned upstream source archives and wheel through a python-wheels-v1 descriptor, materialize a clean closure, verify its complete inventory after donor roots are denied, then rerun the unchanged three short controls. Stop on any short failure.
